title: Cloning of collision shape ID when cloning collider.
body:
### Tested versions

I'm using Godot 4.4, but the bug should be the same in other versions.

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

I cloned some nodes with colliders, and they look right, but when I edit them, the same change is being applied to the other collision shapes that I copied from.

### Steps to reproduce

Take a collision shape node and duplicate it in the editor, and start editing the collision shapes.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'm not sure what an MRP, but here are some files in text form:

project.godot:
